'''Ineas Tikartine''' was an [[Artist/Legends|artist]] whose [[statuary]] works were highly revered by the curators of the [[Obohn Gallery of the Industrial Aesthetic]]. [[Marn Hierogryph]] tried to sell false Tikartine pieces to the gallery during the [[Mandalorian Wars]].
